hints.text: A whole number times a fraction means that many copies of the fraction. Picture three groups of two fifths.
Each copy has $2$ fifths, so count the fifths in $3$ copies: multiply $3 \times 2$ and keep the denominator $5$.
$3 \times 2 = 6$ fifths, so the product is $\frac{6}{5}$, which is also $1\frac{1}{5}$.

explanation: $3 \times \frac{2}{5}$ means three copies of two fifths added together.
Count the fifths by multiplying the whole number by the numerator: $3 \times 2 = 6$ fifths, or $\frac{6}{5}$.
Five fifths make one whole, so $\frac{6}{5}$ can also be written as the mixed number $1\frac{1}{5}$.
